changelog: Added configurable update check URL in Settings
Added A/B slot update system with elevated swap
Added in-app remote download & apply (no Inno Setup)
Added update URL input field in Settings
Fixed all non-working buttons & API duplicate
Fixed UI text: Shaders → Custom Shaders
Enhanced DLL injector with retry logic
Added skin system with upload & stealer
Premium beta features: multi-instance, auto-backup, profiles, crosshair designer, macro recorder

changelogFull.title: Auto-Update Engine
changelogFull.desc: Complete rewrite of the update system. Downloads, extracts, and applies updates entirely in-app using an A/B slot system with elevated swap. No more running setup.exe for updates.

changelogFull.title: In-Game Overlay (F6 / Right Shift)
changelogFull.desc: 35+ overlay mods including FPS, coordinates, TNT counter, keystrokes, armor status, CPS, day counter, mini-map, and more. Toggle with F6 or Right Shift.

changelogFull.title: Login System
changelogFull.desc: Email, Microsoft, Guest, and Code login options. Persistent sessions with auto-login on startup.

changelogFull.title: Skin System
changelogFull.desc: 9 default skins + custom upload + 3D preview (Three.js) + skin stealer (Premium).

changelogFull.title: Cross-Play Proxy
changelogFull.desc: Built-in Geyser proxy lets Bedrock players join any Java server.

changelogFull.title: CurseForge Integration
changelogFull.desc: Browse and install addons, texture packs, and shaders directly from CurseForge.
